subject.title: macOS update can leave manual-update loop and stale node host causing Gateway restart storm

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for the combined macOS updater-loop failure, or should maintainers split it into narrower launchd-job cleanup, no-op update policy, service recovery, and node-host recovery items before implementation?
rationale: Current main has partial repairs but not a complete fix, and choosing whether same-version updates should still stop/restart services or how broadly launchd updater jobs should be matched requires maintainer product and upgrade-safety intent.

options.title: Keep Canonical Until Split Or Fixed
options.body: Keep this issue open as the combined tracker while maintainers decide and document the narrower implementation boundaries with live macOS proof.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
options.body: Create or designate separate canonical items for stale updater labels, duplicate/no-op update behavior, launchd service recovery, and node-host skew, then close this only after those links preserve the field evidence.

options.title: Defer Runtime Change
options.body: Leave only docs/troubleshooting guidance for now and explicitly accept that some macOS update loops remain manual-recovery cases.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Until Split Or Fixed
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the combined tracker while maintainers decide and document the narrower implementation boundaries with live macOS proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent code history in the affected update/launchd paths and posted repository-member direction on adjacent macOS update lifecycle close conditions.
